title: 第25章 条件第26章 她像是超人
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
夏以苜看向曹宗主，少女含笑的目光隐隐带着几分锐利。
曹宗主一时间竟然被她这个眼神震慑住，僵硬在原地。
她旁边的林朔风面色严肃，似乎是在印证她说的那句，只要她死了，他便发疯创死所有人。
曹宗主眸色晦暗不明，似乎在思索夏以苜的那番话。
在发现的确如她所说的那般后，脸色愈发难看起来。
他堂堂紫云宗的命运，竟然被握在了一个十几岁的凡人少女身上。
哪怕夏以苜已经引气入体，但这在曹宗主眼里，也和凡人没有什么区别。
尤其是这个凡人还将紫云宗害得这么惨，要他如何和她低头？
心里实在憋屈得慌！
“你知不知道因为你们，我们紫云宗这段时间被瑶华宗针对成什么样了？”曹宗主胸口剧烈起伏着，似乎要将心中的愤怒全部宣泄出来。
“瑶华宗停了灵泉水供应，紫云宗的灵植死了一大半，剩下的一半也半死不活，你知道这亏损有多大吗？”
“还有瑶华宗的打压，如今紫云宗的灵植都卖不出去了！”
“被林朔风打伤的那些长老还躺在宗里，救治他们也是一大笔消耗！”
曹宗主带来便是紫云宗剩下的所有的长老。
“造成这一切的都是你们，难道不应该由你们来承担这些损失吗？你们怎么好意思再与我谈什么条件？！”
曹宗主越说越气，唾沫星子横飞。
“尤其是你，林朔风！”曹宗主指尖直指林朔风的鼻子，“紫云宗养了你们这么多年，你们就是如此回报紫云宗的？”
“一群养不熟的白眼狼！”
周围村民们更惊讶了，这几日跟着苜丫头身边，唯苜丫头马首是瞻的三人，竟然是紫云宗的仙人？
苜丫头那样指挥他们做事，村民们还以为这三人是苜丫头的跟班呢！

陆兜兜和陆萍萍低下了头，不停抠着手，表情难堪又局促。
就连林朔风也有几分动摇，打伤长老那件事，终究是他做得不对。
夏以苜一看他们三人的状态，便知道他们此刻心里在想什么。
也没有怪他们的意思，这三人被曹宗主pua了那么久，如今顶不住是很正常的事。
“你这套说辞对林朔风他们来说有用，但我可不吃你这一套。”夏以苜站起身。
林朔风知道，这是他姐要火力全开的前兆。
曹宗主皱起了眉，夏以苜一口一个林朔风，这般不客气，林朔风竟没有一点反应？
真将这凡人当姐了？
“紫云宗如今的局面不是你们自己作的吗？与林朔风他们有什么关系？”
“若是你不让人拦着林朔风来救我，紫云宗能落到这种地步？”
“我真死在岳冉的手下，你觉得林朔风会怎么做？他会乖乖听你的安排继续和岳冉联姻？不一剑将你和岳冉的心串一串就是好的了。”
“到了那个时候，瑶华宗必定和紫云宗不死不休，林朔风伤了几个长老换来一个还能挽回的机会，你们紫云宗就偷着乐吧。”
曹宗主涨红了脸，向来有效的话术失去了作用，没想到还有比他更能说会道的人。
照夏以苜这么说，他是不是还得感谢他们？
“少和我说什么从前你对林朔风他们怎么样，你心里想的是什么，你自己心里清楚。”
“今日我在这里，你便别想用你从前那套来对付林朔风，就算林朔风同意了也没用，因为他说了不算，我说了才算。”
content_en:
Xia Yihuo looked at Sect Master Cao. The girl's smiling eyes were slightly sharp.
Sect Leader Cao was shocked by her look for a moment and froze in place.
Next to her, Lin Shuofeng looked serious, as if to confirm what she said, as long as she died, he would go crazy and kill everyone.
Sect Leader Cao's eyes were dim and unclear, as if he was thinking about Xia Yilu's words.
After finding out that it was indeed what she said, her face became even more ugly.
The fate of his majestic Ziyun Sect was actually decided by a teenage mortal girl.
Even though Xia Yiluo had introduced Qi into his body, in the eyes of Sect Master Cao, he was no different from a mortal.
Especially since this mortal had caused so much harm to the Ziyun Sect, how could he bow to her?
I feel really frustrated!
"Do you know what happened to our Ziyun Sect due to the Yaohua Sect's attacks during this time because of you?" Sect Leader Cao's chest was heaving violently, as if he wanted to vent all the anger in his heart.
"The Yaohua Sect has stopped the supply of spiritual spring water. Most of the Ziyun Sect's spiritual plants are dead, and the remaining half are also half dead. Do you know how big the loss is?"
"There is also the suppression by the Yaohua Sect. Now the spiritual plants of the Ziyun Sect cannot be sold!"
"The elders injured by Lin Shuofeng are still lying in the sect. Treating them is also a huge expense!"
Sect Leader Cao brought all the remaining elders of Ziyun Sect.
"It's you who caused all this. Shouldn't you be responsible for these losses? Why do you have the nerve to negotiate any terms with me?!"
Sect Leader Cao became angrier and angrier as he talked, and spittle flew everywhere.
"Especially you, Lin Shuofeng!" Sect Master Cao pointed his fingertips directly at Lin Shuofeng's nose, "The Ziyun Sect has raised you for so many years, and this is how you repay the Ziyun Sect?"
"A bunch of ignorant white-eyed wolves!"
The surrounding villagers were even more surprised. In the past few days, the three people who had been following the girl, and she was the only one who followed her lead, turned out to be immortals from the Ziyun Sect?
The villagers thought that these three people were her followers because of the way Yatou ordered them to do things!
Lu Doudou and Lu Pingping lowered their heads and kept picking at their hands, looking embarrassed and embarrassed.
Even Lin Shuofeng was a little shaken. After all, he did something wrong in injuring the elder.
Xia Yihuo looked at the state of the three of them and knew what they were thinking at the moment.
I don't blame them. These three people have been manipulated by Sect Master Cao for so long, and it is normal for them to be unable to withstand it now.
"Your rhetoric is useful to Lin Shuofeng and the others, but I won't accept your rhetoric." Xia Yihuo stood up.
Lin Shuofeng knew that this was a sign that his sister would go all out.
Sect Leader Cao frowned. Xia Yishuo spoke to Lin Shuofeng in one mouthful. He was so rude, but Lin Shuofeng didn't react at all?
Do you really think of this mortal as your sister?
"Isn't the current situation in Ziyun Sect your own fault? What does it have to do with Lin Shuofeng and the others?"
"If you hadn't stopped Lin Shuofeng from rescuing me, would the Ziyun Sect have ended up in this situation?"
"I really died at the hands of Yue Ran. What do you think Lin Shuofeng will do? Will he obey your arrangements and continue to marry Yue Ran? It would be better if I don't string together your and Yue Ran's hearts with one sword."
"At that time, the Yaohua Sect will definitely fight to the death with the Ziyun Sect. Lin Shuofeng injured several elders in exchange for a chance to recover. You Ziyun Sect can just have fun secretly."
Sect Master Cao's face turned red, and his usually effective words lost their effect. He didn't expect there to be someone more eloquent than him.
According to Xia Yiluo, does he still have to thank them?
"Don't tell me what you said to Lin Shuofeng and the others in the past. You know what you are thinking."
"I'm here today, so don't think about using your old tactics to deal with Lin Shuofeng. Even if Lin Shuofeng agrees, it's useless, because it doesn't matter what he says, it's what I say."
